title: Discover visible Accounts and express explicit workspace choice without creating authorization

requirements.invariant: One authorized-Account snapshot is bound to exactly one compiled target environment and stable Ledger Principal and contains only unique stable Account IDs plus visibility-safe nonblank display names; duplicate names remain valid distinct Accounts.

The snapshot carries exact completeness, ready/partial/stale quality, local-data version and finite observation time so complete ready zero is distinct from loading, partial, stale, unavailable or failed discovery and local evidence never claims fresh server authority.

Presentation order is deterministic by normalized display value and stable Account ID, except that a remembered ID currently present may be placed first; a missing remembered ID is ignored and equal display names remain distinct.

Zero, one and many results all require an explicit choice. Selection creates one environment-, Principal-, Account- and exact-snapshot-bound local intent only for a visible row; discovery, ordering and remembered state never auto-select.

Unknown, removed, rebound, changed-snapshot, malformed or tampered selection evidence fails atomically through stable bounded non-enumerating outcomes and never reveals provider, Auth, membership, financial, invite, logo, token or endpoint data.

Account discovery uses one authorized local read model, remembered state is convenience only, first-result and hardcoded fallbacks are retired, and selection remains separate from membership enforcement and ordered workspace activation.

AccountQuerying exposes typed authorized local discovery while selection is an application-shell workspace transition rather than a server active-Account record or authorization claim; feature code receives no provider object or generic backend access.

This Phase 1 contract is executable only with deterministic provider-free evidence while the shipped Firebase app stays unchanged; it creates no Auth, membership, activation, schema, RLS, Sync, app/MCP, migration, hosted-resource or production behavior.

items: AccountDisplayName accepts nonblank visibility-safe display text and derives a deterministic comparison value without making names identity. AccountSummary carries only stable AccountID and that display value.

AuthorizedAccountListSnapshot binds TargetEnvironmentIdentity, PrincipalID, unique Account rows, completeness, ListSnapshotQuality, LocalDataVersion, finite as-of time and a canonical SHA-256 fingerprint. Ready quality requires complete evidence.

orderedForPresentation(rememberedAccountId:) moves only a remembered ID present in the snapshot to the front, then orders by normalized display and stable ID; it returns rows only and creates no intent.

WorkspaceSelectionIntent binds one explicit visible Account choice to the exact snapshot fingerprint, environment, Principal, local-data version and finite request time. Construction and decoding revalidate every field.

AccountSelectionPolicy creates no default selection, refuses unlisted/scope/snapshot changes through bounded non-enumerating failures, and AccountQuerying exposes only the scoped discovery-update stream.

postgresSchema.notApplicable: No accounts, memberships, principals, auth_identities, workspace-state or preference table, constraint, index, view, trigger or migration is created.

serverHandlers.notApplicable: No Account discovery RPC, selection command, create/update Account, membership/invite operation, Auth callback or workspace activation handler is implemented.

dataApiGrants.notApplicable: No relation or function is exposed through the Supabase Data API and no grant is added.

rlsPolicies.notApplicable: An authorized-list value or selection intent is not authorization. No membership/financial policy, RLS helper, USING/WITH CHECK clause or database non-enumeration claim is introduced.

syncStreams.notApplicable: No identity-bootstrap or Account-catalog PowerSync Stream, subscription predicate, local table, connector, membership refresh, revocation or workspace stream lifecycle is implemented.

items: Snapshot, discovery update and selection intent are canonical Codable values with exact environment/Principal/version/time/readiness and deterministic fingerprint evidence; decoding reconstructs through the same validators and byte-identical structured restart is required.
Complete-ready empty, ready one/many, partial, stale, waiting and failed-with-optional-cache states remain distinct. Discovery failure cannot fabricate an empty snapshot or a successful selection.

A deterministic in-memory AccountQuerying reference port may prove exact scope and failure/no-false-snapshot behavior; it cannot prove encrypted persistence, physical restart, local unlock, lease validity, current membership, revocation, stream switch or network behavior.

storageMedia.notApplicable: AccountSummary deliberately omits logo AttachmentID and bytes. No upload, cache, signed URL, reference detach, O-023 retention or deletion behavior is present.

appMcp.notApplicable: No Account gate/list UI, remembered-state persistence, root coordinator, MCP list/select tool, request/session binding, transport or contract-catalog registration is added.

migrationReconciliation.notApplicable: No Firebase Account/member document, Auth UID/session, listener, UserDefaults value, root mcpUserState, source export row or production membership is decoded, transformed or reconciled.

observabilityRunbooks.notApplicable: Stable local failures are contract values only; no discovery/selection signal, metric, audit sink, alert or recovery runbook is activated.

items: Implementation remains inside provider-free LedgerTargetCore and tests and does not change or link either application project.

The slice cannot authenticate, prove or mutate membership, grant access, decide offline lease, activate/switch/clear a workspace, persist remembered state, create an Account, define schema/RLS/Sync/provider behavior, migrate source state, deploy, release or cut over.

A-007/A-016, O-023, physical encrypted persistence/switching, app/MCP integration, hosted resources, staging credentials, production profiling and production authorization remain outside this boundary.

verification.expected: Synthetic complete zero/one/many and equal-name snapshots preserve exact scope/readiness/version/time, deterministic remembered ordering, no automatic selection and one exact explicit visible-Account intent containing no provider or authorization data.

Ready/partial/stale/authoritative-empty snapshots, cached failure and explicit selection round-trip byte-identically with exact environment/Principal/Account/fingerprint/version/time/readiness evidence and no Auth, role, permission, logo, token, path or endpoint field.

Blank/control names, duplicate IDs, invalid time/readiness/fingerprint, unknown Account, cross-environment/Principal and changed-snapshot evidence fail atomically through stable bounded non-enumerating diagnostic codes.

A deterministic provider-free AccountQuerying port streams only the requested environment/Principal discovery sequence; wrong scope and a failing port produce no false snapshot or successful selection, and no Account is activated.

verification.owner: pull-request CI Isolated target environment job
verification.expected: The exact implementation commit passes conversion traceability, provider/source-contamination and generated-contract checks, the complete target suite, both staging builds and clean artifacts without changing an application project or claiming Auth, membership, physical switching, schema/RLS/Sync, app/MCP, migration or production behavior.

notes: Decision-independent Phase 1 discovery/selection-intent contract only. The canonical target spec and reviewed identity architecture settle visibility-safe scoped discovery, explicit no-default choice, deterministic remembered ordering, exact-snapshot binding and non-enumerating refusal. A-007/A-016/O-023, fresh server authorization, physical workspace activation/switching, pending-work coordination during switch, Account/membership/invite writers, schema/RLS/Sync/provider, app/MCP, migration, hosted resources, production access and cutover remain fully gated because this boundary performs none of them.
